blocks.text: Maple Ridge Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: Maple Ridge is a designated Speculation and Vacancy Tax area in the Metro Vancouver Regional District list, which frames ownership across all four sub-areas the same way.
The City's growth process that touches every sub-area is Planning for Growth, covering Transit-Oriented Areas (TOAs) and small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) city-wide.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: What the City material does settle is form pressure on the stock around the complexes: SSMUH forms listed by the City include townhouse-form infill alongside suites, garden suites, duplexes, triplexes and fourplexes.

The City's proposed zoning updates focus new housing near transit, within the Town Centre, and where water, sewer, transportation and other infrastructure can best accommodate growth — the pattern that separates West Central sites from Silver Valley and Albion edge sites.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A multi-unit development in townhouse form needs an approved development permit before a building permit application, under the City's Urban Infill checklist.

Town Centre and transit-adjacent townhouse sites sit inside the City's TOA work: the proposed updates introduce four new transit-oriented zoning districts and change density, height and parking rules within them.
Eligible lots beside the complexes can now hold three, four or six SSMUH units, which is the redevelopment pressure a townhouse buyer should price into a purchase next to single-detached lots.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The City mailed a 2026 Budget Highlights newsletter to every property in Maple Ridge, so a seller should hold the current-year figures a buyer asks about.
The Planning for Growth open house was held June 4, 2026 in the Fraser Room at Maple Ridge Public Library, the session where the TOA zoning districts were presented.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Townhomes: development and new projects

items.t: Four new transit-oriented zoning districts (City process, not a single project): proposed updates change density, height and parking within the TOAs, focused on the Town Centre and transit areas. Status: proposed zoning updates presented at the June 4, 2026 open house (as of November 3, 2026).

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Townhomes: costs and taxes

items.t: Maple Ridge's 2026 residential mill rate totals 4.53578 per $1,000 of assessed value, with the municipal general portion at 2.86430.
The 2026 flat water fee is $859.25, and the multi-residential flat water fee is $815.62, the line that applies to many townhouse accounts.
Transit distance is a priced fact for land beside the complexes: a lot within 400 metres of a prescribed bus stop can qualify for six SSMUH units instead of four.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Do not assume a complex's sub-area name settles its zoning: the City directs lot-level questions to the Planning Department, and the checklist shows the answer turns on lot area, containment boundary and transit distance.

faq.q: Does SnapStats publish a townhome-only median for Maple Ridge?

faq.a: In the combined Condos & Townhomes counts for September 2026, East Central (120 listings) and West Central (78) dominate; the main townhome areas are thinner — Cottonwood 34, Albion 18, Silver Valley 15 and Southwest 8 (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).
faq.q: Where is most of Maple Ridge's attached stock?

faq.a: The West Coast Express runs weekday trains between Waterfront (downtown Vancouver) and Mission City, stopping at Port Haney Station (22300 River Road), with Maple Meadows Station serving the city's west side; Haney Place Exchange is the bus hub, including the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus to Coquitlam Central Station.

faq.a: Read the Form B, the bylaws, the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and ask about exterior repairs, pet and rental rules and who looks after the fences, roofs and yards.
faq.q: What should I check on a townhome in Maple Ridge?

faq.a: Most are strata, either a building strata or a bare-land strata, with monthly fees and bylaws. Some are freehold row homes with no strata. The title search tells you which, and it decides which costs and rules apply.
